title: Default quick commands for FPVBuddy, Hobo and Grover
goal: The default list offers Show batteries and Show warehouse/spares (FPVBuddy), Show trip (Hobo) and Grover status, each calling that project's MCP tool
acceptance: Each default names the owning project's tool as that project publishes it; an entry whose tool does not exist yet ships disabled with the reason (FPVBuddy's spares tool is not in fpvbuddy:F-009 yet)
A test lists the defaults against fake servers that offer those tools
privacy: Neutral invented commands, servers and results only; no tokens in configuration examples, tests or logs.
escalation: A command that needs a tool another project has not planned goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: four configuration entries checked against the other projects' published tool names. Not a measurement.
